_note: Default URLs for the measurement agent. Override them with the flags (--merchant-url, --facilitator-url, --rpc-url) or with environment variables. In the facilitator topology there are TWO URLs, because the merchant and the facilitator are separate processes.
_note_token: ADMIN_TOKEN is the MERCHANT's machine token: grep TOKEN ../server/data/admin-credentials.txt. The facilitator's /submit-payment route is public and needs no token.
